notes: Partial: the set has upper density <= 2/3 (terms divisible by 3 are 3*10^j; Lean A007933_three_dvd), the A007933/4/5 conjectures are equivalent (differences lie in the primes), and the conjecture is equivalent to: almost all n coprime to 3 containing a digit 1,3,7,9 have a prime digit arrangement. Exact counts of terms below 10^k for k <= 18 (ratio to numbers coprime to 3: 0.999898 at 10^18). Lower bound open (needs a mean-square local limit theorem for digit counts of primes). Outside Lean: the counting bound for numbers 3*10^j, the equivalences, and the class enumeration (classes.c).
